definition: forming the foundation for everything else
description: On a sandy beach at sunset, with the sea, a striped umbrella and a volleyball net behind, two young women in swimsuits kneel on all fours side by side, laughing, forming the base of a human pyramid. A third young woman in a white swimsuit top and denim shorts crouches on their backs, straightens up with her arms spread wide and her hair blowing, and then throws both arms up in the air. Towels and handprints in the sand are around them.

en.question: What is the woman on top doing?

es.answer: Está de pie sobre sus espaldas.
